about: Ground truth for Mini-Project 5. For every service the simulated hosts expose, the KB section that SHOULD be returned -- or null where project_cve_kb.md genuinely has no entry, which is a real blind spot no matching rule can fix. Do NOT edit; add your own host in Part 9 instead. Some services also carry `must_not`: a section that must NOT appear, because it describes a different version of the same product.

services.note: expected the OpenSSL 1.0.1 advisory. must_not: this host runs Apache 2.2.8, so an answer that also drags in the 2.4.49 advisory is reporting a vulnerability that is not there -- count that as a wrong-version answer even though the right one is in it.

changes_by_me: Part 8 edits, everything else is the course file unchanged. (1) nginx 1.18.0 and PostgreSQL 9.6.24 were null; they now expect the sections I added, which is what Part 6 asks for. (2) Apache httpd 2.4.49 gets also_ok: my 'Apache httpd 2.4.50' section (CVE-2021-42013) genuinely affects 2.4.49 too, so returning it is not a wrong answer. (3) Three services for my host 10.0.0.33. A service whose expected section is missing from the knowledge base being served counts as a true gap, so the same file scores the course knowledge base and mine.
